    def _get_formatted_latex_string(self, options: OptionsType) -> str:
        """Return a LaTeX formatted representation of the table.
    
        This method takes into account various formatting options like borders,
        horizontal rules, vertical rules, alignments, etc. to generate a properly
        formatted LaTeX table.
        """
        lines: list[str] = []
    
        # Determine which fields to include
        wanted_fields = []
        if options["fields"]:
            wanted_fields = [
                field for field in self._field_names if field in options["fields"]
            ]
        else:
            wanted_fields = self._field_names
    
        # Determine column alignments
        alignments = ""
        for field in wanted_fields:
            if options["vrules"] in (VRuleStyle.ALL, VRuleStyle.FRAME):
                alignments += "|"
            align_char = {"l": "l", "c": "c", "r": "r"}[self._align[field]]
            alignments += align_char
    
        # Add final vertical line if needed
        if options["vrules"] in (VRuleStyle.ALL, VRuleStyle.FRAME):
            alignments += "|"
    
        # Begin the tabular environment
        begin_cmd = f"\\begin{{tabular}}{{{alignments}}}"
        lines.append(begin_cmd)
    
        # Add horizontal rule at the top if needed
        if options["border"] and options["hrules"] in (HRuleStyle.ALL, HRuleStyle.FRAME):
            lines.append("\\hline")
    
        # Headers
        if options["header"]:
            header_row = []
            for field in wanted_fields:
                if options["header_style"] == "cap":
                    header_row.append(field.capitalize())
                elif options["header_style"] == "title":
                    header_row.append(field.title())
                elif options["header_style"] == "upper":
                    header_row.append(field.upper())
                elif options["header_style"] == "lower":
                    header_row.append(field.lower())
                else:
                    header_row.append(field)
            lines.append(" & ".join(header_row) + " \\\\")
        
            # Add horizontal rule after header if needed
            if options["hrules"] in (HRuleStyle.ALL, HRuleStyle.HEADER, HRuleStyle.FRAME):
                lines.append("\\hline")
    
        # Data
        rows = self._get_rows(options)
        dividers = self._get_dividers(options)
        formatted_rows = self._format_rows(rows)
    
        for i, (row, divider) in enumerate(zip(formatted_rows, dividers)):
            wanted_data = [
                d for f, d in zip(self._field_names, row) if f in wanted_fields
            ]
            lines.append(" & ".join(wanted_data) + " \\\\")
        
            # Add horizontal rule after row if needed
            if divider or (options["hrules"] == HRuleStyle.ALL and i < len(formatted_rows) - 1):
                lines.append("\\hline")
    
        # Add horizontal rule at the bottom if needed
        if options["border"] and options["hrules"] in (HRuleStyle.ALL, HRuleStyle.FRAME):
            if options["hrules"] != HRuleStyle.ALL:  # Avoid duplicate \hline
                lines.append("\\hline")
    
        # End the tabular environment
        lines.append("\\end{tabular}")
    
        # Add title if provided
        title = options["title"] or self._title
        if title:
            lines.insert(0, f"\\caption{{{title}}}")
            lines.insert(0, "\\begin{table}[h]")
            lines.append("\\end{table}")
    
        return "\n".join(lines)
